post.description: Picks a member to run work on, a read of the table as a whole that writes nothing: of the members match keeps, leaving out those exclude names, the first by order of the open members prefer keeps, then of its near ones, then of the other open and near ones. A member counts as out while its table's Capacity has no room for it. With none it answers member null and until, the soonest time a member match keeps may be back, so a caller waits on a deadline of its own. It reads at most 2000 members.

post.description: Records a check of the member at its provider, made now. With room it opens an out member whose outUntil has come, near when near says so, and keeps an open or near one open or near as near says; a check with room before an out member's outUntil records checkedAt alone. With no room the member is out until the later of its outUntil and resetsAt, or outForMs from now when the check names no time, and its recheck is armed then, or recheckAfterMs from now when that is later. Needs permission.
